{{Season|Summer}} in the Valley |xp = 16 [[Farming#Experience Points|Farming XP]] |sellprice = 100 |edibility = 15 |color = Brown }} The '''Taro Root''' is a [[Vegetables|vegetable]] [[Crops|crop]] that grows from [[Taro Tuber]] after 10 days, or 7 days if the crop is planted near water. Taro Root plants do not need to be watered if they are planted near water. ==Stages== {| class="wikitable roundedborder" style="text-align:center;" !Type !Stage 1 !Stage 2 !Stage 3 !Stage 4 !Harvest |- | |[[File:Taro Stage 1.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Taro Stage 2.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Taro Stage 3.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Taro Stage 4.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Taro Stage 5.png|center|link=]] |- | Non-Irrigated | 1 Day | 2 Days | 3 Days | 4 Days |Total: 10 Days |- | Irrigated | 1 Day | 1 Day | 2 Day | 3 Days |Total: 7 Days |} ==Crop Growth Calendar== {{#lst:Crop Growth Calendars|Taro Root}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Jodi,Kent,Leah,Leo,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus |dislike=Abigail,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Sam }} ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header}} {{:Poi|RecipeRow}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== A Taro Root can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Shirt And Belt]]. [[File:Shirt159.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *Three Taro Roots may be requested by [[Blue Discus]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5. *Ten Taro Roots may be requested by [[Blue Discus]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 10. *[[Caroline]] may request 100 Taro Roots in the [[Quests#Island Ingredients|"Island Ingredients"]] Special Order. The reward is gold equivalent to 50% of base crop price and the [[Solar Panel]] recipe. ==Trivia== *After harvesting a Taro Root, the ground underneath it will remain watered for the rest of the day. ==History== {{History|1.5|Introduced.}} {{NavboxCrop}} [[Category:Vegetables]] [[de:Taro-Wurzel]] [[es:Raíz de taro]] [[fr:Racine de taro]] [[it:Radice di taro]] [[ja:タロイモの根]] [[ko:토란]] [[hu:Tarógyökér]] [[pt:Inhame-coco]] [[ru:Корень таро]] [[tr:Gölevez Kökü]] [[zh:芋头]]
